applicability: Imports of the anchor-observation vocabulary and the family member-source reference.
conditions: Callers import these names from models/knowledge/read.py or models/knowledge/review_family_context.py.

Family examination: no joint obligation is supported. Basis: A module-placement and import-compatibility obligation; it guarantees nothing about what a reviewer sees and shares no joint behaviour with the region guarantee.
exclusions: Behaviour of the moved values, which the extraction does not change.
statement: The anchor-observation vocabulary lives in models/knowledge/read_anchor.py and the family member-source reference with its locator-state rule lives in models/knowledge/review_family_source.py; read.py and review_family_context.py re-export them unchanged.
